findings.title: carried forward unchanged from rounds 4 and 5: the sequence field in the `order` message is still not separated from the constant 2L
findings.failure_scenario: Re-measured this round, not carried on trust: replacing `+ e.sequence()` with `+ 2L` in the "runs out of order within the delta at sequence " message leaves all 376 sequencer tests green. Both fixtures that assert that string place the permuted delta at sequence 2, so a single asserted string cannot tell the field from a literal equal to it (1L is killed, by aStreamOutOfOrderOnlyInALATERPairIsStillCaught). Consequence if the field really were a constant: a failing simulation seed reporting 'the delta at sequence 2' for a permutation at any other sequence -- the exact string the fixture's own comment says is how a pinned seed gets debugged. Killing it needs the sequence asserted in a SECOND fixture at a different sequence. Not blocking, produces no wrong result today, and belongs in the commit body or a backlog row -- NOT a seventh round.
